inspections.scope: Complete supervisor, caller/workflow, exact inputs, unchanged Job helper and permanent test interface. Native source pins, ordinary execution paths, Node25.2.1, two unskipped real cases, process/cache observations and full retained evidence match the accepted task.

Complete revised supervisor/workflow/inputs/helper: complete assigned/returned Job snapshot, byte length and unique positive PID validation, bounded same-query resampling/resize, existing kill-on-close ownership, held caller process handle, quiescent Job before/after checks, observed supervisor exit, deadlines, exact source preservation, Action pins and evidence retention.

resolved_findings.finding: A returned-PID count alone can hide an incomplete Job snapshot.
resolved_findings.resolution: Require equal assigned/returned counts and complete validated bytes; resample only the same read-only query within eight reads/500ms, cap1024. No command is replayed.
